description: This PHP file defines a final class 'DeprecationCollector' that collects deprecation messages from Twig templates in specified directories or from provided iterators. It uses PHP's directory and error handling features to parse templates and gather deprecation notices.

classes.name: DeprecationCollector
classes.description: A utility class that collects deprecation messages from Twig templates in specified directories or from an iterator.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DeprecationCollector with a Twig Environment instance.

methods.name: collectDir
methods.description: Collects deprecations from templates within a directory, filtered by extension.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects deprecations from an iterator of template contents, capturing deprecation warnings during template parsing.
